name: mod.yagens_attributes.hunter_munitions

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Additional proc probability at level 0, relative to a unit probability of 1. Scales with (level + 1), sums with other unit-basis additions, and clamps to [0, 1] per qualifying hit. Critical-triggered procs roll once per hit, regardless of critical tier; they do not require matching damage or a status-chance roll.
